findings.title: Double quotes do not survive every hazard: a path containing " breaks the command, and $ or backtick content is expanded inside the double quotes, silently mangling the path; the instruction does not warn about these or tell the agent to refuse such a path.
findings.evidence: Literal extracted command from .claude/agents/idea-planner.md run against: embedded " → `bash: -c: line 6: unexpected EOF while looking for matching `"'`; $VAR fragment → argv[1] with $VAR stripped, FileNotFoundError; backtick fragment → command substitution, path mangled. Guidance text at .claude/agents/idea-planner.md:157-159 and agent-workflows/idea-planner-agent.md:137-139 names only spaces and apostrophes. No slug-sanitization rule is enforced in src/governance or ADR/GOV text.
findings.consequence: $/backtick remain a real, demonstrated silent-corruption path the current instruction text does not warn about; " is a loud failure.
findings.minimal_fix: Name ", $ and backtick in the caution note and tell the agent to refuse/escalate rather than substitute such a path, since no quoting style in this command shape survives all three.
